newsitem.title: USA: Honda says to recall some 1995 Accords.
newsitem.headline: Honda says to recall some 1995 Accords.

text.p: American Honda Motor Co Inc said on Wednesday it would conduct a voluntary recall on some 1995 Accord models to replace the airbag electronic control unit.
The campaign would affect 164,139 vehicles, the company said.
Honda said the unit may cause an unexpected deployment of airbags. In some instances the unit has deployed the airbags as a result of an impact to the suspension or underbody of the vehicle.
The company said that no serious injuries have been reported to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration or to it.

This type of unexpected airbag deployment could result in abrasions to the hand, arms or face to a properly positioned front seat occupant, or potentially more serious injury to an out-of-position occupant.
Affected Hondas were built in Ohio and Sayama, Japan, the company said.
